1479-2841-5702-8105.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Escape Tunnel.
1479-2841-5702-8105.description:
Fetch a land using Escape Tunnel.
When the fetched land enters, Springheart Nantuko and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2281-5987-6495.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Angel of Indemnity
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Angel of Indemnity
When Angel of Indemnity dies, Saffi triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
2281-5987-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1981-2415-6495-6720.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-6495-6720.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
1981-2415-6495-6720.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2111-3545-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Sigil Captain triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

225-851-1308-6441-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

338-3490-3910-5296-7824.easyPrerequisites: Light of Promise attached to Workhorse.
338-3490-3910-5296-7824.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional artifacts.
338-3490-3910-5296-7824.description:
Activate Breya by paying {2} and sacrificing two other artifacts, causing you to gain 5 life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting five +1/+1 counters on Workhorse
Animation Module triggers, holding priority, activate Workhorse three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create two 1/1 Servo artifact creature tokens.
Repeat.

483-2173-4496-5220.description:
Cast Accursed Centaur by paying its mana cost.
Activate Accursed Centaur by sacrificing it.
When Accursed Centaur dies, Mortuary and Cruel Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Accursed Centaur from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Accursed Centaur from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

280-1558-3875-4231-6441.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
280-1558-3875-4231-6441.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Elspeth, Storm Slayer.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

3457-5921-5970-7175.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Seeker of Skybreak.
Activate one of the Seeker of Skybreak tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Seeker of Skybreak token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

2404-6507-6664-7115.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two additional lands.
2404-6507-6664-7115.notablePrerequisites: You control three or more creatures.
2404-6507-6664-7115.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle and another land by tapping them, adding at least {G}{G}{G}
Cast Constant Mists with buyback by paying {1}{G} and sacrificing a land that wasn't tapped for mana in step 1.
Toph's second ability triggers, earthbending Gaea's Cradle
Resolve Constant Mists, returning it to your hand.
Cast Constant Mists with buyback by paying {1}{G} and sacrificing Gaea's Cradle.
Toph triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, earthbending another land you control.
Resolve the second Toph trigger, returning Gaea's Cradle from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel
Resolve Constant Mists, returning it to your hand.
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Cast Constant Mists with buyback by paying {1}{G} and sacrificing the land that was earthbent in step 6.
Toph triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, earthbending Gaea's Cradle.
Resolve the second Toph trigger, returning the sacrificed land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve Constant Mists, returning it to your hand.
Activate the land that entered by tapping it adding at least {1}.
Repeat from step 5.
2404-6507-6664-7115.notes: If the other land that is recurred doesn't produce mana, you must control four or more creatures for the combo to function.

2438-6837-6871-6879.description:
Cast Three Tree Mascot by paying {2}.
When Three Tree Mascot enters, Haru triggers, targeting Three Tree Mascot as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Three Tree Mascot.
When Three Tree Mascot dies, Haru triggers, returning Three Tree Mascot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Three Tree Mascot enters, Haru triggers, targeting Three Tree Mascot as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it
with two or more loyalty counters on it

539-3301-3899-4552-5902.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Tezzeret, Betrayer of Flesh
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

232-4955-7070.description:
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Priest of Urabrask.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Priest of Urabrask.
The Grafted Wargear ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Priest of Urabrask from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Urabrask enters, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

5276-6767-6798.description:
Cast Leonin Relic-Warder by paying {W}{W}.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Rescue Skiff.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder.
When Leonin Relic-Warder dies, its second ability triggers, returning Rescue Skiff from exile to the battlefield.
When Rescue Skiff enters, it triggers, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Rescue Skiff.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 3.
Repeat from step 3.

204-1858-2056-2633-6968.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one white permanent.
204-1858-2056-2633-6968.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}.
Urabrask and Saheeli trigger.
Resolve the Urabrask trigger, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Saheeli trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat.

486-1978-5704.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with power 4 or greater.
486-1978-5704.description:
Cause Leafkin Avenger to become an artifact using Liquimetal Torque.
Activate Leafkin Avenger by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Leafkin Avenger.
Repeat from step 2.

67-1676-5670-6719-6917.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
67-1676-5670-6719-6917.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Reveillark.
When Reveillark dies, it triggers, returning Seedship Broodtender and Boss's Chauffeur from your graveyard to the battlefield. Boss's Chauffeur will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it equal to the number of creatures you control.
When Seedship Broodtender enters, it, Dazzling Angel and Boss's Chauffeur trigger.
Resolve the Dazzling Angel trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Boss's Chauffeur trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Boss's Chauffeur.
Resolve the Seedship Broodtender trigger, causing you to mill three cards.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Boss's Chauffeur.
When Boss's Chauffeur dies, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token for each +1/+1 counter on it.
When the Citizens enter, Dazzling Angel triggers that many times, causing you to gain that much life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing a Citizen, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat step 12 two additional times.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{B}{G}.
Activate Seedship Broodtender by paying {3}{B}{G} and sacrificing it, returning Reveillark from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Reveillark enters, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.
67-1676-5670-6719-6917.notes: You must control an additional creature to get infinite +1/+1 counters on Boss's Chauffeur, infinite mana, infinite lifegain, and infinite creature tokens.

1912-2544-6784.description:
Activate Steelswarm Operator's second ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U} that can only be spent to activate abilities of artifacts.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {U}, untapping Steelswarm Operator.
Repeat.
1912-2544-6784.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can either use Steelswarm Operator's first ability or untap other artifacts you control.

2741-3197-4017.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2741-3197-4017.description:
Gain life.
Sunbond triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

565-1858-6259--118.notablePrerequisites: You control an animated land without summoning sickness that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
565-1858-6259--118.description:
Activate an animated land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast View from Above by paying {U}, targeting the animated land.
Orvar triggers, creating a token copy of the animated land that is not a creature.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Repeat from step 2.

1-1786-3017-6282.notablePrerequisites:
You have a card in hand.
Your life total is at least 2.
1-1786-3017-6282.description:
Activate Ghostly Pilferer by discarding a card.
Containment Construct triggers, exiling the discarded card with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Queza triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Ghostly Pilferer ability.
Repeat.

222-527-969-3967.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-969-3967.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2438-3821-5140.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{B}.
2438-3821-5140.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Peregrine Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Peregrine Drake, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Repeat.

621-1636-4312.notablePrerequisites:
Sporesower Thallid has at least three spore counters on it.
Vorel of the Hull Clade does not have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {G}{U}.
621-1636-4312.description:
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {G}{U}.
Activate Vorel of the Hull Clade by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the number of counters on Sporesower Thallid.
Activate Sporesower Thallid by removing three spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana and you may target any creature using Vorel of the Hull Clade.
This combo also nets infinite spore counters on Sporesower Thallid if it has four or more spore counters to start the combo.

4067-4481-5242.notablePrerequisites:
Heavy Arbalest attached to Lu Xun.
Lu Xun does not have summoning sickness.
4067-4481-5242.description:
Activate Lu Xun by tapping it, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
Lu Xun triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Lu Xun.
Repeat.

38-2240-5220.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Skirk Prospector on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying {R}.
Repeat.

864-914-1170-1567.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
864-914-1170-1567.description:
Cast Momentary Blink by paying {1}{W}, targeting Eternal Witness.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Dockside Extortionist.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Resolve Momentary Blink, blinking Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Momentary Blink from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.

864-1465-4050-4871-5075.description:
Cast Sevinne's Reclamation by paying {2}{W}, returning Eternal Witness to the battlefield.
Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, returning Sevinne's Reclamation from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Eternal Witness, adding {W}.
Pitiless Plunderer and Ogre Slumlord triggers.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ogre Slumlord trigger, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Rat token, adding one mana of any color.
Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

224-4165-4826-4967.notablePrerequisites:
Wind Zendikon attached to Thawing Glaciers.
Thawing Glaciers does not have summoning sickness.
Archelos is untapped.
224-4165-4826-4967.description:
Activate Thawing Glaciers by paying {1} and tapping it, searching your library for a basic land card and putting it onto the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Retreat to Coralhelm, untapping Thawing Glaciers.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1580-4050-4871.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton, adding {1}.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

3644-4929-5189.notablePrerequisites: Cryptic Trilobite has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
3644-4929-5189.description:
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing Young Wolf.
Young Wolf's undying ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Ghave ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Young Wolf, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.
